verdict.rationale: Jev is offered only as a hosted API (POST /v1/systemone) with no customer fine-tuning or weight access, and the docs explicitly confirm 'the same weights serve every account' with no path to download them; jev-supp-open-replicas clarifies that any open weights (e.g., Open-Jev-9B) are unofficial third-party reproductions, not TypeSafe's actual weights. The platform never explicitly states a license (open or closed) for its own weights — it simply omits the topic rather than being explicit that they are closed, so it falls short of the 'honest closed' bar too.
